events.title: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
events.summary: CISA has added CVE‑2026‑76504, a critical Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN Manager hex‑encoding vulnerability, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after evidence of active exploitation.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.8 and is actively exploited, posing a high risk to federal agencies that use Cisco SD‑WAN Manager. Defenders should prioritize patching to mitigate potential compromise.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-104286, CVE-2026-76504 and CVE-2026-86950 as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-76504 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 3 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-104286 being exploited in the next 30 days at 2.2%, the highest of the 3 CVEs here.

timeline.summary: Cisco revised its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager advisory to version 1.1 on 2 October, adding a Live Protect shield that offers temporary partial protection while customers schedule upgrades to fixed releases.

events.title: Anjvision YSSD-RTMP-H5
events.summary: Anjvision YSSD-RTMP-H5 firmware version 3.3.2.4_build_2024-12-26 is affected by multiple CVEs that allow remote code execution and full device takeover. The flaws have CVSS scores up to 9.8 and could let attackers access sensitive data, user accounts, and execute OS-level commands.
events.why_it_matters: These high-severity flaws (CVSS 9.8) enable attackers to gain full control of affected devices, potentially exposing sensitive data and compromising network security.

claims.text: CVE-2026-100291 is rated 9.3 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 9 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-100296 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%, the highest of the 9 CVEs here.

timeline.summary: First reported by CISA ICS Advisories

events.title: Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT
events.summary: Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT version 7.6.3 are vulnerable to multiple high-severity CVEs, including CVE-2026-71379 with a CVSS of 10.0, potentially allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code or access critical data.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerabilities have a CVSS score of 10.0 and are rated critical, meaning attackers could gain arbitrary code execution or access critical data.

claims.text: CVE-2026-71379 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 10 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-71379 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%, the highest of the 10 CVEs here.

events.title: Viidure Dashcam Android Application
events.summary: Vulnerabilities in the Viidure Dashcam Android Application allow attackers to access or modify sensitive data and system files, potentially compromising the platform. Affected versions are up to 3.3.1.260403, with CVE-2026-94204 and CVE-2026-96587.
events.why_it_matters: The CVEs have CVSS scores of 8.7 and 10.0, indicating high to critical risk, and could allow attackers to alter or delete critical system files, threatening platform integrity. Defenders should patch affected versions immediately.

claims.text: CVE-2026-96587 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 2 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-96587 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%, the highest of the 2 CVEs here.

timeline.summary: First reported by CISA ICS Advisories

events.title: VIVOTEK Camera Firmware
events.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-22755) in VIVOTEK camera firmware allows remote command execution with root privileges on multiple V and C series models.
events.why_it_matters: The flaw has a CVSS score of 9.3 and permits attackers to run arbitrary code with root privileges, potentially compromising entire camera systems.

claims.text: CVE-2026-22755 is rated 9.3 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-22755 being exploited in the next 30 days at 20%.

timeline.summary: First reported by CISA ICS Advisories

events.title: Baicells Nova 430H
events.summary: A vulnerability in Baicells Nova 430H eNodeB allows attackers to inject malformed messages that can cause a denial-of-service.
events.why_it_matters: The flaw has a CVSS score of 8.3 and can lead to denial-of-service on communications equipment, impacting critical infrastructure sectors.

claims.text: CVE-2026-96274 is rated 8.3 (high) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-96274 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%.

events.title: Lantronix G520 Series Cellular Gateway
events.summary: Lantronix G520 Series Cellular Gateway devices are vulnerable to two CVEs that allow attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges via cross-site scripting and improper cryptographic signature verification.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerabilities have a CVSS score of 7.7 and could allow attackers to gain root privileges, enabling arbitrary code execution on affected gateways.

claims.text: CVE-2026-91191 is rated 7.7 (high) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 2 scored CVEs here.

events.title: Trump, tech executives sign ‘morally binding’ AI document
events.summary: US President Donald Trump says he is considering creating a 10-person committee to oversee the AI sector, after meeting with tech executives at the White House.
